results.overview: Anthony, a real temp, is hired at Rockin' Grandma's Hot Sauce (a fake company) for its annual retreat - the final one for the company's CEO Doug before retirement. Doug's son Dougie Jr. struggles to prove his leadership abilities while a polished private-equity team courts the company for acquisition.
results.name: Jury Duty Presents: Company Retreat

results.original_name: Jury Duty Presents: Behind the Scenes of Company Retreat
results.overview: A behind the scenes look at the making of the Company Retreat, a documentary-style comedy series that follows the annual week-long getaway for Rockin' Grandma's Hot Sauce through the eyes of their new temp worker, Anthony. And behind the scenes audio commentary with cast and crew for all episodes of Company Retreat.
results.name: Jury Duty Presents: Behind the Scenes of Company Retreat
